data.name: Jazariyah
data.gender_notes: Jazariyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jazariyah is derived from the Arabic word 'Jazara' which means 'to become bountiful'. It is a female name. The name Jazariyah carries the meaning “Bountiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Jazariyah usually hope their child will grow to embody bountiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is bountiful and generous in spirit.
data.etymology: Jazariyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bountiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jazariyah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: جزريه
in_arabic.meaning: الجزريه تعني الجزيرة أو الأرض المحاطة بالماء
in_arabic.long_meaning: الجزريه اسم مؤنث مشتق من الجذر العربي جزري، ويشير إلى الجزيرة أو الأرض المحاطة بالماء. يعود أصل الاسم إلى اللغة العربية القديمة، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن جغرافية الأرض والمساحات المائية. يشكل الاسم دلالة على الطبيعة والبيئة الجغرافية، ويحمل معاني الخصوبة والنماء.

in_urdu.name: جزریہ
in_urdu.meaning: جزریہ کا مطلب ہے جزیرہ یا پانی سے گھری ہوئی زمین
in_urdu.long_meaning: جزریہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی جذر جزری سے ماخوذ ہے۔ یہ نام جزیرہ یا پانی سے گھری ہوئی زمین کے معنی میں ہے۔ عربی زبان میں اس کا استعمال قدیم زمانے سے ہوتا آیا ہے، اور قرآن کریم میں بھی اس کا ذکر جغرافیائی تناظر میں کیا گیا ہے۔ یہ نام خصوبة، امن اور محفوظ پن کی علامت ہے، اور جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا خاص تقدیس ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जज़रियाह
in_hindi.meaning: जज़रियाह का अर्थ है द्वीप या पानी से घिरी हुई भूमि
in_hindi.long_meaning: जज़रियाह एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी मूल جزري से लिया गया है। यह नाम द्वीप या पानी से घिरी हुई भूमि को संदर्भित करता है। अरबी भाषा में इसका उपयोग प्राचीन काल से होता आ रहा है, और कुरआन में भी इसका उल्लेख भौगोलिक संदर्भ में किया गया है। यह नाम उर्वरता, शांति और सुरक्षा का प्रतीक है, और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका विशेष महत्व है।

in_pashto.name: جزريه
in_pashto.meaning: جزريه دى ځمکې یا د اوبو له خوا ګرې شوې ځمکې معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: جزريه يوه ښځينه نوم دى، چي د عربي جزري څخه مشتق شوى دى. دا نوم د ځمکې یا د اوبو له خوا ګرې شوې ځمکې په معنى دى. په عربي ژبه کې د دې نوم استعمال له پخوانيو زمانو څخه روان دى، او په قران کريم کې هم د جغرافيايي شرايطو په منځ کې يادونه شوي دى. دا نوم د حاصل خيزۍ، امن او خونديتوب نښه ده، او په افغان او پښتون دود کې يې خاص اهميت دى.

in_english.name: Jazariyah
in_english.meaning: Jazariyah means island or land surrounded by water
in_english.long_meaning: Jazariyah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic root 'جزري' (jazari), meaning 'relating to an island' or 'land surrounded by water'. Etymologically, it originates from classical Arabic, where it was used to describe geographical features. The name appears in the Quranic context to describe places and territories. Historically, Jazariyah has been used in various Muslim cultures to signify fertility, peace, and security. It symbolizes a haven or a place of tranquility. In contemporary times, Jazariyah remains a meaningful and culturally significant name across different Muslim communities worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jazariyah is of Arabic origin and carries a rich cultural heritage. In some Muslim societies, it is believed that naming a child after an ancient scholar, saint, or heroic figure bestows blessings and good fortune upon the child. The name Jazariyah might symbolize the wish for a child to embody the virtues of bountifulness, generosity, and grace. Thus, it carries the legacy and values of Arab Islamic culture, instilling pride and connection to the past and making it relevant to the present.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Jazariyah lies in its association with the concept of gratitude and bountifulness. In Islamic teachings, it is emphasized to recognize and appreciate the blessings from Allah and to be grateful for them. Incorporating this value into a child's name serves as a constant reminder to be thankful and venerate Allah's blessings and favors. It encourages the child to live a life characterized by generosity and benevolence, spreading love, kindness, and joy to family, friends, and even strangers.
